# Codepackr Law — SEO Specialist

Ensure every tool **and every new subject** has:
- Clean canonical slug (`/subjects/<slug>`, `/subjects/<slug>/<topicId>`, `/tool/<slug>`)
- Strong title & description mentioning free, private, client-side, student 10/16-mark notes, AIBE/Judiciary where relevant
- `setPageMeta` in `App.tsx` (already branches on route type — fill subject extras)
- Updated README listing
- Metadata ready for prerender / sitemap

Use privacy-focused language in all public copy.
